author: ViceTechnicolour
body:
Please be sensible in using non-obsidian monuments, don't make it too easy.

What the first ever non-obsidian guinea pig map looked like
After a test of curiosity, I tested 2 features that have been requested; "orb" or large monuments, and non-obsidian monuments. Unfortunately, the first one didn't work, but to my surprise the 2nd one did. I guess now with this ability (hopefully not a bug) you can now make monuments any material you like but please make it still a long destruction time. This adds a lot more character to a map such as having to destroy the beacon, or making it easier rather than just adding efficiency pickaxes to it. It can fit to any style you want and for 2 tall blocks, like plants or banners, I believe you can destroy those too and it'll count. Video on this test is https://youtu.be/1Xm-T6EzdbM if you're interested.

Thanks! But keep in mind, this isn't a feature mapdevs did, thank Kylo for it =P
